title: feat(store): add Durable Object store with workerd integration tests
quote: Adds a built-in atomic store backed by Cloudflare Durable Objects, so tempo.session() channel state and replay protection work on Cloudflare Workers. ... One Durable Object per key (idFromName(key)), so channels scale out across objects and each channel's updates stay linearizable across isolates.

title: feat(store): add SQL store for Postgres, SQLite and D1
quote: Replaces #1185 as one signed commit (main requires signed commits; #1185 carried unsigned merge commits). Same content as #1185's reviewed head 813b073.

title: feat(server): expose settlement recovery primitives
quote: After an ambiguous broadcast (timeout, dropped connection, already known, 5xx), mppx polls for the receipt until confirmationTimeoutMs or 2s past validBefore. If none appears, it used to rethrow the raw RPC error, so callers had to reclassify it and lacked the hash. It now throws BroadcastOutcomeUnknownError with transactionHash ... and validBefore, with the RPC error as cause.

title: fix(tempo): tag preflight simulation failures and keep the signed zero priority fee
quote: preflightSponsorship now wraps a failed sender simulation, and a failed sponsored simulation (when the out-of-gas tolerance doesn't apply), in a new Errors.PaymentSimulationError ... Callers can now tell a payer's insufficient balance from a sponsor's without matching node messages.

title: fix(tempo): simulate sponsored transactions with the fee payer signature
quote: Sponsored payments failing on Tempo mainnet starting 07:21 PST on 2026-11-05 ... Tempo nodes recover a transaction's fee payer only from a feePayerSignature field, ignoring a bare feePayer address, but mppx's sponsored-simulation path left that field unset.
